What if simply watching classes is not enough to improve your UPSC preparation?

Nikhil Sir explains why UPSC cannot be treated as a passive learning exercise. From daily MCQs and PYQs to writing one answer every day, the focus has to be on actually using what you study.

The idea is simple: read, practice, submit, get evaluated, improve and repeat.

Because UPSC is not just about acquiring knowledge. It is about being able to apply that knowledge when it matters.
